title: Exploration rewards: visible sacrifice reward and result toasts
description: Core Mine, Volatile Fuel Source and Expedition let a player remove 1 infantry from the explored planet to gain a reward. The decision now shows the card, the planet, what is lost (1 infantry) and exactly what is gained; each answer button says what it does. After every exploration (planet or frontier, every seat) a corner toast tells the result in plain words. Before shots are taken on the commit without the change (TI4_SHOT_PREFIX=before); after shots are regenerated by npm run screenshots -- CA. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server.

shots.heading: Before: Core Mine, desktop
shots.caption: Only the card text and two vague buttons: the reward is not named.

shots.heading: After: Core Mine, desktop
shots.caption: Planet, 'You lose: 1 infantry on this planet', 'You gain: gain 1 trade good', and buttons that say what they do.

shots.heading: Toast: your own exploration
shots.caption: Result of the sacrifice: gained 1 trade good, removed 1 infantry.

shots.heading: Toast on a phone
shots.caption: The toast sits in the bottom corner clear of the map controls.

shots.heading: Toast: another player's fragment
shots.caption: Seen by every seat; relic fragments are kept face up.

shots.heading: Toast: frontier exploration
shots.caption: Frontier token explored in a system.

notes.title: Engine
notes.text: The sacrifice choice carries display-only offer details (card, planet, lose, gain, captions); options, ids and context are unchanged. ExplorationRecord gained display-only system and result fields (skipped when empty, not compared).

notes.title: Web
notes.text: useCornerToasts reads state.exploration_log (public, like the face-up cards) and toasts each finished record once, for every seat; entries present at load or after undo/redo do not toast.
